security.captcha_public_help: When disabled, public auth forms skip the captcha field.
security.captcha_admin_help: When disabled, the admin login form skips the captcha field.

2fa.enabled_status: Two-factor authentication is active on this account.
2fa.enrollment_required: Two-factor authentication setup is required before continuing.
2fa.required_banner: Your administrator requires two-factor authentication. Complete setup below.
2fa.recovery_lead: Save these codes in a safe place. Each code works once if you lose your authenticator.
2fa.recovery_code_help: Use a recovery code instead of the 6-digit app code.
2fa.login_lead: Enter the code from your authenticator app or a recovery code.
2fa.reset_confirm: Reset two-factor authentication for this admin?

categories.has_products: Remove or move products before deleting this category.
categories.has_children: Remove or move subcategories before deleting this category.
categories.name: Name

categories.sort_help: Used among siblings. Drag in the tree to reorder.

categories.slug_exists: That slug is already in use.

categories.products_empty: No products in this category yet.
categories.add_products_help: Check an item to add it to this category, set the price, then save.

categories.pricing_help: Set a price (and quantity) for each selected item, then confirm.
categories.no_items_selected: Select at least one item to add.

products.details_help: Players buy the fixed quantity at the listed cash price.

economy.title: Economy health
economy.lead: Item census and market signals from periodic snapshots. Run the economy tick cron to refresh.
economy.confirm_mass_watch: Add selected items to the watchlist?
economy.confirm_mass_unwatch: Remove selected items from the watchlist?
economy.tick_stale: Census is missing or older than 2 hours.
economy.tick_hint: Run: php bin/economy-tick.php (or schedule it every 15 minutes).
economy.yang_help: Yang totals are stored supply. Player shops and ground yang are not included.
economy.census_caveat: Counts are stored items only (inventory, equipment, safebox, mall, pending awards). Ground items and open player shops are invisible.
economy.item_lead: Supply history, shop-sale medians, recent trades, and drop sources.
economy.no_census: No census row for this vnum yet. Run the economy tick.

advice.consider_lower_drop: Supply up and price down — consider lowering drop chances.
advice.consider_raise_drop: Supply down and price up — consider raising drop carefully.
advice.demand_died: Supply and price both down — demand may have died; do not dump more.
advice.supply_up_no_price: Supply rising (no reliable price signal yet).
advice.supply_down_no_price: Supply falling (no reliable price signal yet).

economy.price_caveat: Prices come from the item log SHOP_SELL hint (yang + count). goldlog is unused when empty.
economy.chart_yang_supply_help: Player + safebox + guild gold over the last {days} days. Rising = more stored yang.
economy.chart_market_volume_help: Yang traded in player shops per day (last {days} days).
economy.chart_yang_flow_help: Daily net from money_log (last {days} days). Positive = inflationary day.
economy.spark_empty: Not enough history for a chart yet.
economy.chart_supply_help: Units in circulation (inventory, safebox, mall, pending) from daily census.
economy.chart_price_help: Shop-sale median yang per unit. Use with supply: up+cheap → too much drop; down+expensive → scarce.
economy.players_lead: Wealth concentration (character gold) and shop buy/sell leaders for the selected period.
economy.players_empty: No wealth snapshot yet. Run the economy tick.
economy.player_lead: Investigation view: shop trades, yang transfers, and alerts. Signals only — not automatic bans.
economy.player_yang_help: Snapshot of player.gold only (safebox not included in rankings).
economy.transfers_help: From goldlog EXCHANGE_GIVE / EXCHANGE_TAKE. One side of the pair may be missing.
economy.units_delta_help: Net change vs yesterday’s census (proxy for create/destroy; ground/shops invisible).
economy.wealth_help: Based on character gold only. Top percentages of players by gold holdings.
economy.empty: No census rows. Run the economy tick.
